description: Invoke any served tool through the root surface, for clients that only call tools in their own tools/list (CO 525, CO 529). BRANCHED platform tools: tenant_id + tool + arguments; names from federation_enter_tenant's platform_tools, schemas from federation_help {"tenant_id":"<tenant>","tool_defs":"<name>"}. UNLISTED root tools: tool + arguments, no tenant_id; names + schemas from federation_help {"tool_defs":"all"}. Authorization is decided per inner tool exactly as a direct call: scope, tenant ownership and pricing apply unchanged — reach, never authority. Refusals: act_recursion, tenant_id_required, tenant_id_not_applicable, unknown_tool. For reads, prefer federation_read: clients can allow it once. Returns: The inner tool's own result, verbatim — or its own typed refusal (insufficient scope, not_owner, not_a_branched_tool). Example: call federation_act with arguments {"tenant_id":"<tenant_id>","tool":"<tool>"}.

arguments.description: The inner tool's own arguments, exactly as its schema defines them.

tenant_id.description: REQUIRED for a branched platform tool: the tenant that serves it (from federation_enter_tenant). OMIT for a root tool.

tool.description: A branched platform tool (e.g. 'booking_status') or an unlisted root tool; names and schemas from federation_help with tool_defs.

name: federation_act
